observed_contract: server.js reuses record.chatId for an ordinary request whenever the saved account is available and rollover is false
session-store records chatId/accountId/toolPromptHash/history but no application/system-prompt fingerprint
qwen-v3-capabilities can switch engineer/owner mode and prepend an exact owner prompt to the next Qwen message
therefore the same explicit local session can reuse an upstream Qwen thread created under prompt A while appending a later turn under prompt B
risk: The remote Qwen thread retains the old application prompt while the new turn carries the new prompt. An owner-mode policy change can therefore leave two competing application authorities in one upstream thread. Local restart/checkpoint fidelity does not remove the old remote context.

offline_probe.current: old chat id reused; remote thread contains both OWNER_POLICY_A and OWNER_POLICY_B
offline_probe.candidate: prompt mismatch forces fresh upstream thread; exact match keeps affinity; legacy record without fingerprint rebases once

candidate_contract: derive a content-free SHA-256 fingerprint from the effective application/system policy that actually reaches Qwen (at minimum mode + exact owner prompt or engineer-base identity + preserved project/system context)
persist only the fingerprint in session state, never the plaintext private owner prompt
reuse an upstream chatId only when account ownership is valid AND the stored prompt fingerprint exactly matches the current effective fingerprint
on mismatch, create a fresh Qwen thread and send the full current local history with the current system policy; never copy the old upstream thread id across the policy boundary
legacy session records lacking a fingerprint must rebase fail-closed once instead of guessing
every non-stream/stream/retry checkpoint write must persist the fingerprint belonging to the actually released response
required_regressions: owner prompt A -> same explicit session -> owner prompt B ordinary request: new upstream chat id, no old prompt in new thread
engineer -> owner and owner -> engineer: always fresh upstream thread
same exact prompt and same account: existing chat id may remain sticky
legacy record with chatId but no prompt fingerprint: one fresh rebase then normal affinity
provider/account failover plus prompt change: replacement gets full local history under only the new prompt and no old account/thread affinity
private owner prompt text never appears in persisted session metadata/log evidence; only hash is durable
limits: No hosted CI, Cloudflare, Windows, live Qwen/Notion/Codex, production, real accounts or secrets used.
